d: Short, platinum white hair with choppy bangs and a slight side-parted fringe. The eyes are a bright, glowing light blue with a cheerful, smiling expression. Appearing as a late teenager with a slender build, the character wears a white and navy blue sleeveless high-collared dress featuring a deep V-neckline and gold metallic accents. Signature details include a dark grey mechanical wolf-head accessory perched atop the head and a long, ornate silver sword held across the shoulders.
